# Designing Api Versioning

## Core principle

Evolve public API behavior without surprising existing consumers. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a private API with no compatibility obligation
- a one-time data migration without an interface contract
